description: Compound interest calculator with an interactive chart. Works out what a starting amount and monthly deposits grow to at a fixed rate, compounded daily, monthly or yearly, and gives the APY. Use it for savings growth, CD and high-yield savings balances, future value at a fixed rate, and questions like what $10,000 becomes in 10 years at 5%. People ask for it as "compound interest calculator", "daily compound interest calculator" or "how to calculate compound interest".

annual_rate_percent.description: Yearly interest rate as a percent, so 5 means 5%.

compounding.description: How often interest is added to the balance.

per_month.description: Dollars added at the end of each month.

name: compound_interest
title: Compound Interest Calculator
